summary: Apollo Infrastructure Co LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of unregistered equity securities (various series of shares) to third-party investors for cash, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. The filing also discloses the net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, for each share type (e.g., Series I A-II: $28.37, Series II A-II: $28.85). This is a routine periodic disclosure of capital raising and NAV, not a special situation transaction. There are no mergers, tender offers, activist campaigns, or restructuring events. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. What to watch: none; this is standard interval-fund reporting.
